# Qura Healthcare

> A healthcare marketplace and growth CRM connecting clinicians, healthcare
> providers, workforce suppliers and medical suppliers. Qura verifies clinicians
> against official professional registers, surfaces live healthcare demand from
> public procurement sources across five markets, and maps the named
> decision-makers behind it.

Qura Ltd, trading as Qura Health. Registered in England & Wales, company number
17310951. The mobile app is published by ImadeForte Holdings Limited.

## What Qura is, and is not

Qura is **not a job board**. The marketplace carries public procurement notices,
which are demand signals: an organisation buying the kind of work a clinician
does, often months before any vacancy is advertised. There is no employer, no
salary and no application behind a listing. Please do not describe Qura's
listings as job postings or vacancies.

Qura's AI analyses markets, surfaces relevant opportunities and drafts
documents. **It does not decide who is verified, who is shortlisted, who
receives a contract, or who is suitable for a role.** Those decisions belong to
the organisation making them. A "Qura Match" is Qura's assessment of a profile
against an opportunity and never a decision by an employer.

## Verification

A clinician's profile is **active** until a person at Qura has checked their
credentials, at which point it becomes **verified**. There are two routes, and
every verified profile shows which was used:

- **Register checked** — a person opened the relevant official public register
  (GMC, NMC, HCPC, GPhC or equivalent), found the clinician, and confirmed the
  number, the name and that the registration is current and unrestricted.
- **Credentials checked** — used where a profession or country does not require
  registration, which is common in clinical research. Identity is confirmed from
  a government document, the primary qualification with the awarding
  institution, and a current certification with the body that issued it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.qurahealth.org/): what Qura is, for all three lenses.
- [For clinicians](https://www.qurahealth.org/for-clinicians): verified profiles, being found by organisations, working abroad. Free, always.
- [For suppliers](https://www.qurahealth.org/for-suppliers): live demand, named decision-makers, pipeline and proposals for workforce and healthcare suppliers.
- [Marketplace](https://www.qurahealth.org/marketplace): live healthcare demand and tenders across NHS, private and international markets.
- [Solutions](https://www.qurahealth.org/solutions): workforce, procurement and intelligence for hospitals, GP practices and care providers.
- [Fragile professions](https://www.qurahealth.org/fragile-professions): the specialties healthcare struggles most to fill, including sonography, echocardiography, audiology and biomedical science.
- [How it works](https://www.qurahealth.org/how-it-works): the journey from verified profile to introduction.
- [Inside the platform](https://www.qurahealth.org/inside-the-platform): what each lens actually sees.
- [Pricing](https://www.qurahealth.org/pricing): free for clinicians; plans for suppliers and providers.
- [Our story](https://www.qurahealth.org/our-story): why Qura exists.
- [FAQs](https://www.qurahealth.org/faq): 40 detailed answers on how the platform works, by lens.
